en.title: How to Read Chinese City Walls: Gates, Defense, Ritual and Urban Form
en.headline: Read a Chinese City Wall in Material Layers
en.description: Distinguish surviving fabric, conservation repair, reconstruction and archaeological traces, then read gates and streets as parts of an urban system.
en.heroAlt: Nanjing City Wall's southern section beside a road and pedestrian path in April 2024
